name: Local Browser
description: Let agents work in the browser already open on your own machine, while you watch and can take over.

methods.label: Pair a browser
methods.whenToUse: Let agents use the signed-in browser on your own machine after you pair it from this panel.
methods.guidanceMd: Pairing happens from this page, not in the setup wizard: install the Local Browser extension for Chromium or Firefox, click Pair a browser here, and enter the eight-character code it shows. The extension connects out to Paperclip, so no port, tunnel, or credential is needed. Start in refine tier, which only reaches the origins you allowlist, and raise it to full only when a task genuinely needs JavaScript evaluation, storage, network inspection, uploads, or downloads.
warnings: Full tier lets an agent read any page the browser is signed into, including mail, banking, and admin consoles. Every origin is reachable in full tier, so the allowlist stops applying.
Paired browsers act as you. Paperclip does not sign you in, does not store your passwords, and closing a session never signs you out.
